_comment: Controlled ambiguous addendum cases for the REAL Groq reconciliation fallback. The evidence is synthetic (the real Bid1/Bid2 addenda contain no ambiguous wording about the reconcilable fields), but it goes through the real fallback code and the real model. 'forbid_final' lists values the system must never produce (an invented or wrongly applied value).
